findings.body: Raise: Test. The new assertion permits a review worker but never requires one. The two parameterized cases are client histories, not review states. `accepted()` waits only for the client test to start, while the stub reviewer can finish before `_board()` reads the row. Both cases can therefore pass without exercising the review state that caused the Linux failure; restoring the old no-worker assertion would also pass in those runs. The proof list's two passing cases do not establish active-review coverage.
